data.body:
[P2] Establish the external runner contract

Rule 6, “Mark unverified assumptions,” requires evidence or an explicit `unverified` marker for the assumption that the external runner recognizes these declarations and excludes them from `uncovered`. The description supplies neither for this metadata contract. The new declaration test only reads the YAML; it cannot establish that the runner consumes it, which is essential to the claimed CI fix. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and document this contract with supporting runner documentation or validation, or explicitly mark it unverified for maintainer review.
